summaries: A Form 10-K Annual Report for Arvana Inc. covering the fiscal year ended December 31, 2021. Relevant to the task: It contains audited financial statements showing a Loss from Operations of $102,704 for 2021. However, the document does not contain financial results for 2022, 2023, or 2024, meaning it provides only the baseline operating loss immediately preceding the requested 2022–2024 trend period and lacks the specific data points required to analyze the trend itself.

A Form 10-K Annual Report for Arvana Inc. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2022. Relevant to the task: The document provides audited Consolidated Statements of Operations showing a Loss from Operations of $165,831 for 2022, with zero revenue reported for the period. It notes the Down2Fish acquisition closed in February 2023, post-fiscal year end, indicating 2022 results reflect pre-acquisition operations. It does not contain financial data for 2023 or 2024, limiting the trend data available from this document to the single 2022 operating loss figure.

A Form 10-K Annual Report for Arvana Inc. for the fiscal year ended December 31, 2023. Relevant to the task: It provides the audited Consolidated Statements of Operations, reporting a Loss from Operations of $530,922 for 2023, compared to $165,831 for 2022 within the comparative columns. This supplies the 2023 operating data point necessary to extend the trend analysis initiated in the 2022 report, showing a widening operational loss. However, the report does not contain financial results for 2024, so it cannot establish the full 2022 to 2024 trend based on this document alone.
